newsitem.title: USA: Baldwin Piano to sell organ unit to Kuhn.
newsitem.headline: Baldwin Piano to sell organ unit to Kuhn.

text.p: Baldwin Piano & Organ Co said on Tuesday it agreed to sell its church organ systems division to Kuhn Keyboards Inc for an undisclosed sum.
Kuhn Keyboards was organized by Duane Kuhn, a former Baldwin vice president who headed the organ division.
The sale must be approved by Baldwin's principal lender, the company said.

Baldwin has been under pressure recently from Kenneth Pavia Sr, a partner in Bolero Investment Group LP, to explore ways to increase shareholder value, including the possibility of a merger. But a Baldwin spokesman said the organ unit sale had been planned for awhile and was not prompted by Pavia's comments.
Baldwin shares closed Monday at 12-3/4. Their 52-week high was 16-1/2.
